items.title: Active authority
items.decision: Only docs/Omnevum-MPES-v0_18_0.md and docs/Omni_3.32.0.md govern the active overhaul.
items.why: Deprecated implementation-era overlays must not shape current product decisions.

items.title: Launchpad route
items.decision: Reject retaining NeumanOS as the application UI/authority after the reproduced Notes failure and duplicate-store inspection; continue with the existing Omnevum greenfield shell plus selective, contract-bound donor harvest/reference.
items.why: The route-reassessment receipt compares fork/adapt, harvest, and greenfield options after a material OMN-FOSS-014 failure. One canonical owner, command, Vault, Recovery, and static-host contracts dominate broad but unqualified donor surface.

items.title: Role-specific donors
items.decision: Kurumi, OneBench, and Utopia are evaluated by seam; no donor becomes a second canonical owner.
items.why: A scalar winner would import incompatible runtime and ownership assumptions.

items.title: Qualification reset
items.decision: All prior capability statuses and acceptance evidence are requalified from UNKNOWN under v0.18.0.
items.why: Overhaul requires current-source evidence rather than inherited claims.

items.title: Optional surfaces
items.decision: AI, sync, connectors, and extensions remain optional and truthfully degraded until their gates close.
items.why: The no-AI/local core and canonical safety boundaries are mandatory.

items.title: Route reassessment after donor failure
items.decision: The existing Omnevum shell is the selected implementation route; NeumanOS, Kurumi, OneBench, and Utopia remain bounded role-specific references unless a future adapter passes the same owner, target, license, security, migration, and Recovery gates.
items.why: The exact current NeumanOS Notes error and duplicate module-owned stores falsified retaining its UI, while the existing shell already supplies the controlling canonical and release spine.
